title: 过程参数与闭包 / Procedure-valued parameters

checks.name: closure linked to its caller -> reads apply-twice's n

closure-links-caller.reason: wrong: a procedure parameter's static link = whoever calls it
closure-links-caller.explain: 过程值必须带上定义处的环境（outer 的 AR）；改成调用者后，addn 看到的是 apply-twice 的 n。

access-dynamic-chain.reason: wrong: resolve non-local names along callers
access-dynamic-chain.explain: 动态链上离 addn 最近的是 apply-twice，于是取到 n = 1000。
